scripts.dev:landing: bun install --cwd web && bun install --cwd landing && bun run --cwd landing dev
scripts.dev:docker: bun run build:native && bun run build:wasm && docker rm -f bowerbird-dev bowerbird-web-dev; docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.snapshots: bun run scripts/cargo.ts run --profile quick --manifest-path native/rawshim/Cargo.toml --example snapshot_diff --
scripts.get:all: bun run get:shell && bun run get:libavif && bun run get:libjxl && bun run get:tauri
scripts.get:shell: bun run get:slangc && bun run get:pmrid
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e-tauri/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p landing/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:native: bun run scripts/cargo.ts build --profile quick --manifest-path native/rawshim/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:wasm: bun x wasm-pack@0.13.1 build native/rawshim --target web --out-dir pkg --no-opt -- --no-default-features && bun run scripts/hash-pkg.ts
scripts.e2e:tauri: bun run e2e:tauri:build && bun run scripts/e2e-tauri-full.ts
